sentences.text:
THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH P.S.
 GARHA DISTRICT JABALPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI PRAMOD CHOUBEY - GOVT. ADVOCATE AND SHRI VIDYA  PRASAD - ADVOCATE FOR THE OBJECTOR )
This application coming on for admission this day,

the c  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is a repeat bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 13.9.2022 in connection with Crime No. 563/2022, registered at Police Station Garha District Jabalpur for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N), 506 of the IPC and Section 5(1)(6) of the POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix as well as her mother have been examined.
In the said deposition, no allegation of rape is made against the applicant.
In these circumstances, applicant who is under trial prisoner may be enlarged on bail.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the State as well as counsel for the objector have opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that in 161 statement prosecutrix has stated that applicant had raped her.
Further prosecutrix is minor aged about 13 years.

In these circumstances,
applicant may not be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Material witnesses have already been examined in the Court and now there is no chance that applicant will be influenced the witnesses.

Applicant is in jail since 13.9.2022.
6.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

8. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE DUBEY/-
